items.information: Online registration ends on 21st November, 2017. On the spot registration is available if the total registration is less than 160 participants. Visit [registration and payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/APJBLDOpen2017#2861-registration-payment) tab for details. If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration. ***First time participants*** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab. ***Other participants*** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab. The winner of MBLD event will be declared the competition winner.

items.name: Weston-super-Mare Open 2017
items.information: Registration opens on Friday 1st September, 7pm BST. The steps for registration are as follows: * Login with your WCA account, or create an account in the top-right. * Register for the competition on the left. * Once you receive an email and are on the waiting list, pay the fee on the [UKCA website](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/weston-super-mare-open-2017/registration). * Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. If you can no longer make it, please inform us as soon as possible so we can give the place to someone else.
